mapper.sql: select g.segment_id,g.session_id,s.platform_session_id,date(s.live_start_time),g.room_id, coalesce(r.room_name,s.reported_room_name),g.anchor_user_id,coalesce(u.nick_name,concat('用户#',g.anchor_user_id)), s.live_start_time,g.start_time,g.end_time,greatest(timestampdiff(second,g.start_time,g.end_time),0), coalesce(g.watch_delta,0),coalesce(g.interaction_delta,0),coalesce(g.new_fan_delta,0), coalesce(g.deal_delta,0),coalesce(g.gmv_delta,0),coalesce(g.ad_cost_delta,0),coalesce(g.presale_order_delta,0), case when coalesce(g.watch_delta,0)=0 then 0 when coalesce(g.exposure_watch_rate,0)>0 then round(g.watch_delta*100/g.exposure_watch_rate,4) else null end, coalesce(g.exposure_watch_rate,0),coalesce(g.watch_follow_rate,0),coalesce(g.watch_interaction_rate,0),coalesce(g.watch_deal_rate,0), g.source,g.precision_status, case when g.end_time is null or g.end_time<=g.start_time or g.room_id is null or g.anchor_user_id is null or coalesce(g.watch_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.interaction_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.new_fan_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.deal_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.gmv_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.ad_cost_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.presale_order_delta,0)<0 then 'INVALID' when timestampdiff(hour,g.start_time,g.end_time)>12 or g.precision_status<>'EXACT' or g.source='MANUAL' or (coalesce(g.watch_delta,0)>0 and coalesce(g.exposure_watch_rate,0)=0) or (s.status='LIVE' and s.live_start_time<now()-interval 36 hour) then 'WARNING' else 'VALID' end, nullif(concat_ws(',', if(g.end_time is null or g.end_time<=g.start_time,'INVALID_TIME',null),if(g.room_id is null,'MISSING_ROOM',null), if(g.anchor_user_id is null,'MISSING_ANCHOR',null), if(coalesce(g.watch_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.interaction_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.new_fan_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.deal_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.gmv_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.ad_cost_delta,0)<0 or coalesce(g.presale_order_delta,0)<0,'NEGATIVE_METRIC',null), if(timestampdiff(hour,g.start_time,g.end_time)>12,'LONGER_THAN_12H',null), if(g.precision_status<>'EXACT','NON_EXACT',null),if(g.source='MANUAL','MANUAL_SOURCE',null), if(coalesce(g.watch_delta,0)>0 and coalesce(g.exposure_watch_rate,0)=0,'MISSING_EXPOSURE_RATE',null), if(s.status='LIVE' and s.live_start_time<now()-interval 36 hour,'SESSION_STALE',null)),''), g.version,g.create_time,coalesce(g.update_time,g.create_time),now(),0, sha2(concat_ws('|',g.segment_id,g.session_id,s.platform_session_id,g.room_id,g.anchor_user_id, date_format(g.start_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),date_format(g.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), coalesce(g.watch_delta,0),coalesce(g.interaction_delta,0),coalesce(g.new_fan_delta,0),coalesce(g.deal_delta,0), coalesce(g.gmv_delta,0),coalesce(g.ad_cost_delta,0),coalesce(g.presale_order_delta,0), coalesce(g.exposure_watch_rate,0),coalesce(g.watch_follow_rate,0),coalesce(g.watch_interaction_rate,0), coalesce(g.watch_deal_rate,0),g.source,g.precision_status,g.version),256) from live_metric_anchor_segment g join live_metric_session s on s.session_id=g.session_id left join live_room r on r.room_id=g.room_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=g.anchor_user_id where g.status='CLOSED' and g.end_time is not null
mapper.insert:
insert into bi_live_anchor_segment_fact ()
and (not exists(select 1 from bi_live_anchor_segment_fact bx where bx.segment_id=g.segment_id) or exists(select 1 from bi_live_anchor_segment_fact bx where bx.segment_id=g.segment_id and ( bx.source_version<>g.version or bx.source_updated_at<>coalesce(g.update_time,g.create_time) or bx.is_deleted=1 or ((s.status='LIVE' and s.live_start_time<now()-interval 36 hour) and find_in_set('SESSION_STALE',coalesce(bx.quality_flags,''))=0) or ((s.status<>'LIVE' or s.live_start_time>=now()-interval 36 hour) and find_in_set('SESSION_STALE',coalesce(bx.quality_flags,''))>0) ))) on duplicate key update
mapper.update: update bi_live_anchor_segment_fact set is_deleted=1,synced_at=now() where segment_id=#{segmentId} and is_deleted=0

update bi_live_anchor_segment_fact b left join live_metric_anchor_segment g on g.segment_id=b.segment_id set b.is_deleted=1,b.synced_at=now() where (g.segment_id is null or g.status<>'CLOSED') and b.is_deleted=0
mapper.select: select source_count sourceCount,bi_count biCount,source_duration sourceDuration,bi_duration biDuration, source_watch sourceWatch,bi_watch biWatch,source_interaction sourceInteraction,bi_interaction biInteraction, source_new_fan sourceNewFan,bi_new_fan biNewFan,source_deal sourceDeal,bi_deal biDeal, source_gmv sourceGmv,bi_gmv biGmv,source_cost sourceCost,bi_cost biCost, source_presale sourcePresale,bi_presale biPresale, (source_count=bi_count and source_duration=bi_duration and source_watch=bi_watch and source_interaction=bi_interaction and source_new_fan=bi_new_fan and source_deal=bi_deal and source_gmv=bi_gmv and source_cost=bi_cost and source_presale=bi_presale) matched from (select count(*) source_count, coalesce(sum(greatest(timestampdiff(second,start_time,end_time),0)),0) source_duration, coalesce(sum(watch_delta),0) source_watch,coalesce(sum(interaction_delta),0) source_interaction, coalesce(sum(new_fan_delta),0) source_new_fan,coalesce(sum(deal_delta),0) source_deal, coalesce(sum(gmv_delta),0) source_gmv,coalesce(sum(ad_cost_delta),0) source_cost, coalesce(sum(presale_order_delta),0) source_presale from live_metric_anchor_segment where status='CLOSED' and end_time is not null) s cross join (select count(*) bi_count,coalesce(sum(duration_seconds),0) bi_duration, coalesce(sum(watch_count),0) bi_watch,coalesce(sum(interaction_count),0) bi_interaction, coalesce(sum(new_fan_count),0) bi_new_fan,coalesce(sum(deal_count),0) bi_deal, coalesce(sum(gmv_amount),0) bi_gmv,coalesce(sum(ad_cost_amount),0) bi_cost, coalesce(sum(presale_order_count),0) bi_presale from bi_live_anchor_segment_fact where is_deleted=0) b
